data_fields.name: park_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: 20 percent of town size (data; code default equals shop radius)

data_fields.name: building_skip_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: one_in(4) skip per side per step (BUILDINGCHANCE 4), so 3 in 4 tries

data_fields.name: entry_redraw_tries
data_fields.donor_constant: no cap in donor (do/while); sketch uses 20

data_fields.name: side_street_jitter
data_fields.donor_constant: rng(1,3) shorter than arm size; a length of 1 is bumped to 2

data_fields.name: block_width_alternate
data_fields.donor_constant: rng(3,5) for a width-2 arm, else 2

data_fields.name: seed_clearance
data_fields.donor_constant: candidates within 2 tiles removed after each seed

data_fields.name: loop_edge_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: one_in(10) for an extra edge inside one subgraph

best_idea: Grow each town from one hub as four arms with side streets at block-sized gaps, and place its services one building at a time by ring distance from the centre, with unique landmarks tracked per town.
decision_why: The growth grammar and ring rule fit a build-time zone generator that writes zone data; the donor's unbounded redraw, silent give-up and comment mismatch must be fixed first, and its random tile grid is dropped.
acceptance: A player entering a fresh zone with seed S sees the same town on server and client, shops near the centre and houses at the rim, at most one copy of each unique landmark per town, and a server test fails if a catalogue bin with no fitting entry does not return null.
